articles.title: Cash Memer is now live on Android
articles.subtitle: The full point-of-sale, now in every Pakistani shopkeeper's pocket
articles.summary: After months in testing, the Android edition is out today on Google Play — with AI receipt scanning, live rates, history and cloud backup, free and ad-free.
articles.author: Umer Butt
articles.authorBio: Builds Cash Memer end to end — from the receipt engine to the pixel on your dashboard. Based in Lahore.
articles.heroAlt: Cash Memer running on an Android phone
articles.seoTitle: Cash Memer is now live on Android — Google Play launch
articles.seoDescription: The Android edition of Cash Memer is out today: AI receipt scanning, live currency rates, history and cloud backup — free and completely ad-free.
articles.content:
It's official — Cash Memer for Android is available today on Google Play. What started as a weekend tool for a single shop counter is now a full point-of-sale you can carry in your pocket, in English or اردو.

What's inside

Everything the desktop and iPad editions are known for, tuned for a phone: professional cash memos with a live preview, discounts and tax, custom currencies, and a branded digital signature.

The star of this release is the Gemini-powered AI receipt scanner. Snap a photo of any paper receipt — or bulk-import a whole folder — and the app parses the items, totals and dates for you in seconds.

Safe and synced

Sign in with Google and every receipt syncs securely through Firebase, so you can move between phone, tablet and desk without losing a thing. Prefer to stay offline? Export a full JSON or raw SQLite backup any time.

What's next

The iPhone edition is in final testing for the App Store, and CarPlay and Android Auto builds are on the way. One account, every device.

Grab it today, and tell us what to build next.

articles.subtitle: Point your camera at a receipt and watch the form fill itself
articles.summary: Our new OCR scanner reads items, quantities, totals and dates from any paper receipt and auto-populates a clean cash memo — including bulk imports.
articles.author: Umer Butt
articles.authorBio: Builds Cash Memer end to end — from the receipt engine to the pixel on your dashboard. Based in Lahore.
articles.seoTitle: AI receipt scanner powered by Gemini — Cash Memer
articles.seoDescription: Cash Memer's Gemini-powered OCR reads any paper receipt and auto-populates a clean cash memo, with single and bulk imports.
articles.content:
Typing out receipts is the part nobody enjoys. So we handed it to the AI.

How it works

Tap Scan Receipt, point your camera at a paper slip, and Gemini reads the merchant, line items, quantities, prices and totals — then drops them straight into a fresh cash memo for you to review.

Bulk scanning

Have a shoebox of receipts? Choose Bulk Scan, select multiple images at once, and the app processes them in a queue. Perfect for month-end catch-ups.

Accuracy & privacy

Scans are processed securely and never used for ads. You always get a chance to review and edit before anything is saved.

articles.title: How we keep your books private
articles.subtitle: Biometric locks, on-device data and honest defaults
articles.summary: A look at Cash Memer's security model — App Lock with Face/Touch ID, a custom passcode fallback, and data that stays yours.
articles.author: Umer Butt
articles.authorBio: Builds Cash Memer end to end — from the receipt engine to the pixel on your dashboard. Based in Lahore.
articles.seoTitle: How Cash Memer keeps your books private
articles.seoDescription: Cash Memer's security model: biometric App Lock, custom passcode fallback, on-device data and no ads.
articles.content:
Your sales are nobody's business but yours. Here's how we keep it that way.

App Lock & biometrics

Turn on App Lock and Cash Memer requires Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode every time it opens or returns from the background.

A custom passcode fallback

Set a private 4-digit passcode as a secure fallback — handy when biometrics aren't available.

No ads, ever

We don't run ads and we don't sell data. Your records sync only to your own Google account, and you can export or wipe them whenever you like.

articles.title: Five tips for faster receipts at the counter
articles.subtitle: Small habits that shave seconds off every sale
articles.summary: From barcode scanning to default signatures and quick currencies, here are five ways to speed through a busy counter.
articles.author: Umer Butt
articles.authorBio: Builds Cash Memer end to end — from the receipt engine to the pixel on your dashboard. Based in Lahore.
articles.seoTitle: Five tips for faster receipts — Cash Memer
articles.seoDescription: Speed through a busy counter with barcode scanning, default signatures, quick currencies and more.
articles.content:
A busy counter rewards small habits. Here are five that add up.

1. Scan, don't type

Use the barcode scanner or an external hardware scanner to ring up known products instantly.

2. Save a default signature

Capture your signature once and turn on Save as Default so every memo is pre-signed.

3. Pin your currencies

Add just the currencies you actually use so the picker is short and fast.

4. Turn on auto-share

Let finished memos share or print automatically the moment you generate them.

5. Watch the dashboard

Keep an eye on today's sales and scans so you spot a slow day early.

articles.title: Tutorial: create your first cash memo
articles.subtitle: From empty screen to a printed receipt in under a minute
articles.summary: A step-by-step walkthrough of building a professional cash memo — items, discounts, tax, currency and signature — then sharing it.
articles.author: Umer Butt
articles.authorBio: Builds Cash Memer end to end — from the receipt engine to the pixel on your dashboard. Based in Lahore.
articles.heroAlt: Creating a cash memo step by step
articles.seoTitle: Tutorial: create your first cash memo — Cash Memer
articles.seoDescription: A step-by-step guide to building and sharing a professional cash memo in Cash Memer.
articles.content:
New to Cash Memer? Let's make your first memo together — it takes about a minute.

1. Add the details

Open New Receipt and enter a title, your shop or location, and pick the currency, category and payment type.

2. Add your items

Type each product with a quantity and price, or scan them. The live preview updates as you go and totals calculate automatically.

3. Apply discount & tax

Choose a percentage or fixed discount and add a tax percentage if needed.

4. Sign & share

Draw your signature, tap Generate, and share or print the finished memo.

articles.author: Umer Butt
articles.authorBio: Builds Cash Memer end to end — from the receipt engine to the pixel on your dashboard. Based in Lahore.
articles.seoDescription: Cash Memer 1.4.0: bulk AI scanning, custom currencies, SQLite backup and many fixes.
articles.content:
Version 1.4.0 is rolling out now. Here's everything that's new.

New

Bulk AI receipt scanning, register-your-own custom currencies, and offline backup to a raw SQLite database file.

Improved

Faster rate refresh, clearer sync status, and a tidier Settings screen.

Fixed

Resolved a rare crash on very long histories, corrected a rounding edge case on fixed discounts, and fixed Urdu layout on the signature card.
